summary: Harden authority_io symlink CWD/relative base guards, RFC3339 subseconds, and history reason controls

delivery.outcome: Harden _check_no_symlink_ancestors and resolve_within_examples against un-normalized, relative, CWD, and absolute base bypasses, support 7-9 digit RFC3339 subseconds, reject C0/DEL/newline characters in history reasons, keep all modules strictly below 500 lines, and mark merged ticket-013 DONE.
nonGoals: No runtime execution authority or external network calls
No breaking changes to valid authority grants or profiles

architecture.decision: Move RFC 6901 pointer helpers into src/authority_io.py (re-exported by src/authority_primitives.py), check cumulative raw path prefixes and CWD ancestors for symlinks, reject absolute base paths in resolve_within_examples, normalize >6 fractional RFC3339 digits, and reject C0/DEL control chars in history reasons.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-014 commit via governed PR.
